name: web-deep-violet-glow-rising-from-black-gradient-background
title: Black field with a soft indigo-violet glow rising from the bottom edge in a shallow arch
whatItIs: A plain black frame whose lower third glows deep indigo to violet, brightest at the bottom corners and fading upward along a shallow arch.
whatItMeans: Quiet and atmospheric; a horizon glow suggests dawn behind a dark page.
techniques: Fade a single hue up from the bottom edge.

vocabulary.definition: A glow rising from the bottom edge.
A gradient fading outward from a point.
A background layer under hero content.
